Revenue 5,870,132; cost of sales 5,464,584; gross profit 405,548; selling and distribution cost 123,947 plus operating expenses 442,888 gives operating expenses 566,835; other operating income 158,558 and an exchange gain of 2,078,530 lift the printed operating profit to 2,075,801; finance cost 617,712; profit before taxation 1,458,089; current and deferred taxation printed as nil; profit after taxation 1,458,089; profit per share printed 0.37 kobo, stored as 0.0037 naira. rows.label: EPS

unitGuard.reason: unit guard: the EPS row for 9M 2026 read 3.7 against 0.373869 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 9.897, which is the 10x multiple of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.37, the unit the price is quoted in.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed

marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding

derived_notes.note: Income tax for FY2025 recorded as nil: the audited income statement (FTN Cocoa Processors Plc, year ended 31 December 2025, page 24) prints current taxation and deferred taxation both as dashes, and its loss after taxation equals its loss before taxation. The stored Net Profit equals the stored Profit Before Tax, so a nil charge is the reported position rather than a derived one.

repairs.source: this file's own printed rows: Profit Before Tax and Net Profit are identical in this period, and Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit in every populated year of the file
repairs.note: nil tax charge, written only where profit before tax and net profit are exactly equal; a file whose tax charge is genuinely non-zero was never touched by this rule
